subject: general
question: Who took oath as the Cabinet Minister of the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs in 2019?
solution:
​The correct answer is __**Pralhad Venkatesh Joshi**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A ministry of the Indian government is the** Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs. **The Union Cabinet Minister for Parliamentary Affairs is in charge of it.
 
• It manages the **parliamentary business** and serves as a liaison between the** Lok Sabha** (the lower house, sometimes known as "House of the People") and the **Rajya Sabha** ("Council of States," the upper house).
 
• It started off as a department in **1949** before evolving into a complete ministry.
 
• Allotting government time in the legislature for discussion of motions that members have given notice of. Interaction with the Whips and Leaders of the major Parties and Groups in Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Making decisions and taking action in response to issues brought up under **rule 377** of the rules governing how business is **conducted in the Lok Sabha** and through special mentions in the Rajya Sabha.
 
• The Parliamentary Officers' Salaries and Allowances Act of 1953 (20 of 1953). The Members of Parliament Salary, Allowances, and Pensions **Act of 1954 (30 of 1954)**.
 
• Act of 1977 governing the compensation and benefits of opposition party leaders in parliament (33 of 1977). **Act of 1998 **Concerning Facilities for the Leader and Chief Whips of Recognized Parties and Groups in Parliament (5 of 1999).** **
